description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-18 under road-to-steps-the-skill-cannot-skip AC-1, which repaired dead links in this skill's SKILL.md and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the three uses the SKILL.md lists: wrapping a verbose command, installing rtk on a machine, and writing project-local filters, with a German variant. Near-misses are the token-saving neighbours: the general token decision tree (token-optimizer), packing a codebase for an LLM (repomix-packer), and the case this skill itself forbids — a git diff where completeness matters, which belongs to code-review. Counterexamples guard short commands and the 'filter' homonym in data code.

queries.q: run the full phpunit suite but don't flood the context with the output
set up rtk on this new laptop, including the tee and audit logging
add a project-local rtk filter for our custom deploy script, it prints 400 lines of progress bars
phpstan spits out thousands of lines — wrap it so we only see what matters
installier rtk hier im Projekt und richte die Filter für docker compose logs ein
we're close to the context limit — what's the cheapest way to keep going?
queries.note: a general token-saving decision across reads, handoffs and runs → token-optimizer, which routes to rtk only as one branch

queries.q: pack the whole repo into one file so I can paste it into another model
queries.note: token-conscious, but a codebase packer rather than an output filter → repomix-packer

queries.q: show me the complete git diff of this branch so we can review every change
queries.note: this skill's SKILL.md forbids rtk where completeness matters, git diff by name — the raw diff serves a review → code-review
short command with a one-line answer; SKILL.md says no overhead benefit

queries.q: add a filter to the orders list so admins can search by customer
queries.note: 'filter' as a UI/query feature, unrelated to CLI output
